exposure: obstetric parameters (mode of birth, complications, presence of a birth partner)
cohort: The study included 238 women who had given birth in Cyprus a maximum of two years prior to their participation.
finding: Birth satisfaction was significantly associated with socioeconomic and obstetric factors, with older women, those with previous childbirth experience, and those with a partner present reporting higher satisfaction, while complications during labor were associated with lower satisfaction.
mod_finding: Differences in birth satisfaction were found between women experiencing an emergency cesarean section and those having a vaginal birth.
cross-section timing: Participants were surveyed at a single point in time, between 0 and 2 years postpartum.
